english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for doing something with affection and care.
This is the casual all-purpose choice for doing or saying something in a loving, affectionate way.

examples.english: They lovingly take care of stray cats.
examples.traditional: 佢好有愛咁照顧啲流浪貓。
